newsitem.title: USA: Texas power steady, maintains outage strength.
newsitem.headline: Texas power steady, maintains outage strength.

text.p: Spot electricity prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) held their strength Tuesday with enough maintenance outages in the state to put some constraints on power supply, industry sources said.

Several plants were reported to be out for maintenance, including the Lower Colorado River Authority's 430 megawatt (MW) natural gas-fired Ferguson power plant, which was scheduled to resume output near Wednesday.
Peak, firm electricity in ERCOT for Wednesday delivery was quoted at $22.00-24.00, steady to lower from quotes near $22.00-26.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) on Monday.
Off-peak ERCOT power for Wednesday delivery was also said to be steady at $12.00-13.00 per MWh.
November ERCOT electricity was quoted steady at $19.75-$20.25, while December was assessed unchanged at $21.50-22.00 per MWh, the sources said.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
